svg.title: Zip-tie station 3 position
svg.desc: Two top views of one plate of the two-sided puller, before left and after right, the plug end at the top. Left: the defaults with plug length set to 40 and zip-tie station placement set to Manual, a 20 mm wide plug in teal. Right: zip-tie station 3 position at 58 mm. Marked in red: 1, the arms: the two toothed arms in the upper half. 2, the zip stations: the three small holes along each arm, removed. 3, the zip stations and the strap slot.
